jobs.title: System Integration Senior Engineer (Platform Focus)
jobs.jd:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.

The System Integration Senior Engineer will help lead the Nyx system end‑to‑end integration and verification, with a focus on functional platforms (Software in the Loop Platform, Processor in the Loop Platform, Hardware in the Loop Platform, Functional Simulation Facility). You will define and execute test plans, manage requirement traceability, analyse test results, and close verification evidence across SIL/PIL/HIL and physical test campaigns. Working closely with subsystem leads, AIT teams, and external partners, you will identify integration risks, resolve anomalies, and ensure that all mechanical functions perform safely and reliably throughout the mission profile. This position requires a rigorous systems mindset, strong understanding of mechanical behaviour in the space environment, and the ability to lead multidisciplinary verification activities to successful closure.

Key Responsibilities

In your capacity a System Integration Senior Engineer, your role will continuously evolve, but initially your day-to-day duties will include:

  • Ensure the definition and implementation of the Nyx Earth system integration and verification activities, which meets technical and programmatic requirements and considers the adequacy of model philosophy, facilities availability, planning and costing.

  • Define plans and specifications with clear Success Criteria and support the generation of test procedures with the Functional Platform team.

jobs.title: ECLSS V&V Engineer Intern
jobs.jd:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.

We want you as a talented intern to help us in our mission by contributing to the development, justification and validation of our Environmental Control and Life Support System (ECLSS).

As an ECLSS engineer intern, you will ensure that the system undergoes the correct steps to qualify it for flight. This inter-disciplinary position includes hands-on work on the test benches for the Pressure Control System (PCS), the Air Recirculation System (ARS) and the Crew and Emergency systems (CES). A major part of the work is to ensure the activities are documented properly according to the ECSS development process.

Key responsibilities

In your position as an ECLSS Engineer Intern, your role includes:

  • Verifying NASA ISS requirements applicable to ECLSS components through test and analysis data.

  • Build hands-on on test support equipments (GSEs) and functional test benches.

  • Supporting test activities and validating simulation results against test data for accuracy and reliability

  • Qualifying hardware components for internal designs and externally sourced parts in environmental testing such as vibration, shock and thermal cycling

  • Communicating effectively and providing recommendations through the preparation and presentation of technical data

  • Writing technical documentation and participating in internal and external reviews
